That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Plugins online

The digital economy is expanding rapidly, yet many creators in countries excluded by major payment platforms are left behind. Stripe operates in only 46 of the 195 countries worldwide, leaving a significant gap for those looking to sell digital products. By [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-solutions-when-stripe-paypal-ban-account-plain-5|COREMERCH guide to understanding]]-cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-plain-9|Understanding Cloudflare]] sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can take control of your sales, retain full ownership of your data, and avoid the pitfalls of reliance on platforms that can suspend accounts without warning.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Sovereign commerce infrastructure operates on a combination of free and paid tools that work together seamlessly. Hosting can be done via GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, while backend logic is managed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order storage can be efficiently handled with Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery is managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payment processing is streamlined with NOWPayments, allowing you to receive more than 300 cryptocurrencies with a nominal fee. This architecture is designed for creators seeking autonomy over their online commerce.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. If you're selling plugins, ebooks, courses, or other digital products, this solution empowers you to operate independently. It caters to the needs of those who have experienced financial isolation and seeks to provide a permanent structural alternative that enables you to sell without the restrictions imposed by platforms like PayPal or Gumroad.
Control your digital sales without being locked out by payment processors.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this infrastructure include free hosting solutions, backend logic services, and payment processing tools. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as your storefront, while backend functions are executed through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Using Supabase for order management ensures secure and scalable data storage. Payment processing with NOWPayments guarantees that you can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Each component is selected for its reliability and efficiency, allowing you to build a strong digital presence.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own sovereign commerce stack, start by setting up your hosting with Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Once configured, set up Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payments to complete your infrastructure. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which provides a fully tested setup deployed in just 48 hours. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore your options.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can still sell digital products by utilizing a sovereign commerce stack. This infrastructure allows you to create an independent online store using tools like GitHub Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments. By leveraging these resources, you can accept payments in cryptocurrency and maintain full control over your business.
Retain full ownership of your data and infrastructure—no dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

You can sell digital products by creating your own online store using sovereign commerce infrastructure. Tools like GitHub Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments allow you to bypass traditional payment processors and accept cryptocurrency.
What is the best alternative to Gumroad for creators in restricted countries?

The Edge Commerce Stack is a strong alternative for creators in restricted countries. It provides a comprehensive setup with payment processing and order management, enabling you to sell digital products without reliance on platforms like Gumroad.
Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?

Using PayPal in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan can be problematic due to account restrictions and potential suspensions. To avoid these issues, consider using a sovereign commerce stack that allows you to accept payments independently.
What happens if my PayPal account is suspended?
A PayPal account suspension can hold your funds for up to 180 days without the possibility of appeal. This risk highlights the importance of creating a self-sustaining commerce infrastructure.
How do I ensure data ownership in my digital business?

By using tools like Supabase for order management and hosting your site on platforms like GitHub Pages, you maintain full ownership and control over your data, unlike traditional platforms that dictate terms.
